implementation: Qualified XChaCha20-Poly1305 and historical XSalsa20-Poly1305 Discord RTP boxes; original discord.py packet construction, original Hermes receiver and PCM mixer with explicit float32 operations. This is not a complete Discord voice backend.
runtime_boundaries: discord.voice_client imports standalone.discord_crypto for its four transport modes. No nacl or davey namespace is installed.
Hermes VoiceReceiver preserves the complete credential-generation tuple, authentication failures, rekey threshold, RTP extensions/padding, DAVE state guards and per-SSRC decoder lifetime.

discord.voice_state and discord.gateway import the qualified standalone.dave Session. DAVE v1 MLS and Opus frame encryption are implemented and independently validated; unsupported protocol versions and authentication failures refuse explicitly. See dave-provenance.json.
The bundled discord.opus native loader refuses loading; both default discovery and explicit third-party native library loading are disabled.
Original mixer children, locking, fade counters, duck/release and pause/resume lifecycle remain in the adapter; explicit PCM helpers handle sample arithmetic.

oracles.description: Locally executed libsodium 1.0.18: 30 HChaCha/HSalsa derivations, 30 boxes including authentication corruption, 15 native libopus 1.3.1 packets and decoded PCM, plus 60 native encrypted RTP outputs.
Native libm fmaf IEEE float32 gain and sum for eight complete 20 ms stereo frames; clipping and signed PCM16 conversion.
Reviewed native Skype SILK SDK resampling vectors reused by the WAV consumer tests.

limits: The DAVE v1 MLS and Opus frame-encryption path is implemented; full Discord voice still requires the separate complete pure Opus codec. DAVE video packetizer transforms and general MLS private-message/external-commit features are outside the Hermes Opus consumer. See dave-provenance.json for exact coverage.

A full pure Opus SILK/CELT encoder and decoder is not implemented. The 15 native Opus packet/PCM fixtures verify 60 RTP encrypted wire outputs and future codec work; they do not constitute a Python codec.
Standalone audio-file conversion currently accepts uncompressed mono/stereo integer PCM WAV at 8-48 kHz; compressed formats remain unsupported.
WAV resampling matches the reviewed native Skype SILK SDK vectors; waveform equality with FFmpeg libswresample is not claimed.
Mixer multiply/add/clip retains float32 numerical output. Synthesized ambient noise uses deterministic stdlib Random(7) Gaussian samples, so its noise waveform differs from NumPy PCG64/Ziggurat.
Python integer/stream-cipher arithmetic does not claim constant-time execution.
